# Jorge Gasca

Jorge Gasca is a bilingual Product Specialist, hands-on product builder, and sales automation specialist based in Mexico City, Mexico.

## Current profile

- Current role: Product Specialist at Apollo.io, May 2025 to present.
- Previous highlighted role: Product Development Manager at MiniTiendAI, March 2024 to May 2025.
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (C2), and Portuguese (A2).
- Focus: product delivery, product UX, sales and CRM automation, AI workflows, responsive QA, customer enablement, and web/API delivery.
- Availability: product roles, plus selected sales automation, SaaS, CRM, and AI workflow projects.
